comments: Replace with any overall comment. If Anil.Maddhesia@wolterskluwer.com is not the right person recorded as resolvedBy on the seven ambiguities, correct it here - that identity was taken from the git commit author on this branch, not supplied by name.

itemDecisions.comment: The six named modules are present and can be opened. Covers the presence half of REQ-001 only.
Proposed as DEFER. The absence half of REQ-001, which carries the actual authorization claim. No organization-to-module mapping exists and the account reaches nineteen destinations against six named.
Dashboard offers New Transaction, Workspace and Preferences, and each opens. All three were walked end to end.
Navigation menu offers Home, New Transaction and Workspace, and each opens. These are the entries observation confirms are navigable links.

Preferences is OFFERED in the menu with Organization and Vault beneath it. Deliberately a presence check, not a navigation check - the probe found no navigable link with that label. Mark REQUEST_CHANGES if you intended Preferences to be clickable, since that would make this a product defect.
Organization and Vault open their pages. Note Organization shares a destination with the Dashboard Preferences icon, so arrival must be asserted on page content.
Command Center returns the user to Home. The control carries no accessible name, so its locator will need a VALIDATED waiver.
Proposed as DEFER, per AMB-005. REQ-006 is consequently recorded as UNCOVERED, not met.

Unauthenticated visitor is shown an error message and remains on the sign-in page. This records YOUR STATED EXPECTATION and has not been observed. You punctuated the answer with a question mark - mark REQUEST_CHANGES if you were asking rather than telling.
Proposed as DEFER. Unproducible this release: narrowing scope to the six authorized modules leaves no unauthorized module to request. REQ-007 is therefore partial.
